create_FakeAgent: create a FakeAgent instance with a world object and optional heuristic perception enabled
create_FakePlayer: create a FakePlayer instance with a struct or random entityId for simulated player testing
test_FakeAgent_perceive: test the FakeAgent perceive method to process low level and heuristic perception outputs
test_FakeAgent_set_blocks: test the FakeAgent set_blocks method to place blocks in the world and update memory
test_FakeAgent_add_object: test the FakeAgent add_object method to add a voxel object to memory with relations
